name: Drunkard
author: Ben
summary: After capturing, the piece staggers to a random safe empty tile.
description:
A Common gambit for 3 coins. Every time one of your pieces captures, it doesn't stay to gloat: it staggers on to a uniformly random intact empty tile, anywhere on the board - but drunkard's luck holds, and it never stumbles onto a square an enemy threatens. It might wander deep behind enemy lines or wobble two squares sideways; it just won't fall into a capture doing it. Where it lands is nobody's plan - as often a nuisance as a blessing.

Two sober exceptions: a capture that triggers a promotion is left alone - drunk pawns sober up at the finish line - and if every intact empty tile is threatened, or the board has none at all, the piece simply stays put. The card only relocates, it never kills.
